## Pull request overview This PR updates the Linodego v2 compile-time instrumentation to ensure `linodego.client.operation.duration` can distinguish failures from successes even when no HTTP status code is available, by recording `error.type` on the metric (and propagating the outcome from `finishSpanWithError`). **Changes:** - Extend `finishSpanWithError` to return both `statusCode` and an `errorType` string, and thread it through `afterAPICall` to metric recording. - Update metric attribute construction/recording to accept and emit `error.type` when provided. - Add a `semconv.ErrorType(err)` helper (mirroring net/http conventions) and expand unit tests to cover the new behavior for HTTP and non-HTTP failures. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 5 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | instrumentation/github.com/linode/linodego/v2/semconv/client.go | Adds `ErrorType`, extends metric attribute/recording APIs to include `error.type`. | | instrumentation/github.com/linode/linodego/v2/semconv/client_test.go | Updates tests for new signatures and adds coverage for `error.type` behavior. | | instrumentation/github.com/linode/linodego/v2/public_method.go | Threads `errorType` through from span finalization into metric recording. | | instrumentation/github.com/linode/linodego/v2/hook.go | Extends `finishSpanWithError` to compute/return `errorType` for metrics. | | instrumentation/github.com/linode/linodego/v2/hook_test.go | Adds end-to-end coverage verifying metric attributes for HTTP and non-HTTP failures. |
Suppressed comments (1) **instrumentation/github.com/linode/linodego/v2/semconv/client.go:240** * RecordOperationDuration's docstring describes errorType as only for failures without an HTTP status code, but callers now pass a status-code string for HTTP failures too. Updating the comment avoids misleading future callers. ``` // errorType is the error.type attribute value for failures that carry no // HTTP status code; pass "" for a successful call or one already identified // by statusCode. ```

1. The PR title/description needs an update, since this PR fixes both #879 and #885.                                                                                                      
2. I didn't know about this until PR #1405, but `otel/semconv` provides an `ErrorType` helper. Can we use that instead of manually reimplementing the reflection logic inside `linodego`?
